name: micro-frontend-lab
description: 微前端实现原理演示 — 独立小项目

scripts.dev: concurrently -n runtime,main,dash,settings -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w micro-runtime" "npm run dev -w main-app" "npm run dev -w sub-app-dashboard" "npm run dev -w sub-app-settings"
scripts.build: npm run build -w micro-runtime && npm run build -w sub-app-dashboard && npm run build -w sub-app-settings && npm run build -w main-app
